name: Mishiranu Oyaji ni Itazura Sareteiru Musume o Mite Bokki Shita Chichioya
original_name: 見知らぬオヤジにイタズラされている娘を見て勃起した父親
source: Minori's father noticed that she had been leaving the house often lately. He decided to follow her only to discover that she was exposing herself to a guy on the street, this event awakens a sexual desire for his daughter.
